stories.title: AI layoffs mount amid software sector bloodbath
stories.simple_summary: Tech companies are firing a lot of workers and saying it's because of AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work in tech or know someone who does, job security is becoming less certain in that industry.

stories.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
stories.simple_summary: Many big tech companies have laid off employees this year, and they're blaming AI for needing fewer workers.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows a pattern across the tech industry, but unless you work in tech, your own job is unlikely to be affected yet.

stories.title: North Carolina teen accused of using AI for sexual exploitation. Are state laws strong enough?
stories.simple_summary: A teenager in North Carolina used AI to create sexual material as a way to harm or exploit someone, and the question is whether laws protect people enough.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters if you're a parent — it shows a new way young people can misuse technology to hurt others, and current laws may not catch it.

stories.title: What's the difference between closed, open‑source and open-weight AI? A researcher explains
stories.simple_summary: A researcher is explaining the different types of AI systems and how open or closed they are to the public.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly educational background information — helpful if you're curious about how AI works, but nothing that requires action.

stories.title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
stories.simple_summary: Libraries are running workshops where people learn how to avoid using AI and Big Tech companies.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're concerned about privacy or don't want to use AI, there are now resources at libraries to help you live differently.

stories.title: People Are Starting to Record Every Conversation They Have Without Disclosing It, and It's Gross
stories.simple_summary: Some people are secretly recording conversations without telling the other person, using AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: You should be aware that someone might be recording you without permission — it's worth knowing this happens, even though it's controversial and risky legally.

stories.title: Robert Morris University infuses artificial intelligence into MBA curriculum
stories.simple_summary: A university business school is adding artificial intelligence classes to its MBA program.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're considering business education or have grandchildren exploring careers, MBA programs are now teaching AI as a core skill.

stories.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
stories.simple_summary: When one power line failed in Virginia, it showed that AI data centers (huge computer buildings) don't handle power outages well.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and infrastructure experts — for ordinary people, it's a warning that AI infrastructure needs to be more reliable.

stories.title: The AI jobs apocalypse probably isn’t coming anytime soon
stories.simple_summary: Experts believe that AI probably won't cause massive job loss right away, despite people's worries.
stories.why_it_matters: If you've been worried about AI stealing jobs quickly, this suggests things will likely change more gradually than some people claim.

stories.title: Silicon Valley Splits Over Closing the Borders to Chinese A.I.
stories.simple_summary: Tech leaders in Silicon Valley disagree about whether to restrict China's access to advanced AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and government policy — it's a political debate that doesn't directly affect your daily life or small business right now.

stories.title: From Silicon Valley to DC, the tech world is suddenly obsessed with one concept in AI: Distillation
stories.simple_summary: Tech leaders and government officials are excited about something called 'distillation' — a technique to make AI systems smaller and faster.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly an engineering conversation among tech experts — nothing you need to understand or worry about for now.

stories.title: Have we lost our control over AI already?
stories.simple_summary: People are asking whether we've already lost the ability to control AI systems that are becoming very powerful.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a philosophical debate about the future — experts disagree, and there's no action to take right now, but it reflects genuine uncertainty about what comes next.
